channel.title: Hotel Buffets on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Hotel Buffets on YumFam

item.title: Xiamen Yubaofu Boiled Live Fish Set Meal for 3–4 People — ¥138 (≈$19), Free Island-Wide Delivery
item.description:
Deal price: boiled live fish set for 3–4 people — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥269, about 49% off) · Valid through Dec 31, 2026 · Delivery or pickup — no dine-in

Yubaofu （鱼宝福） in Wenzhao is one of Xiamen’s busiest boiled-fish restaurants — the kind of place locals queue for. This deal brings the signature dish to you: a whole fresh live fish, cooked in a bubbling spicy broth with plenty of sides, enough for 3–4 people at about ¥35 a head, with a big bottle of Coke included. It is delivery or pickup only — there is no dine-in on this deal. Delivery is free anywhere on Xiamen island (except Gulangyu), or pick it up from the Wenzhao shop yourself. Book 4 hours ahead; usable 09:00–13:30 and 16:00–21:00.

item.title: W Xiamen NINE Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22): German Food Theme Lunch or Dinner, 1 Adult + 1 Kid Under 1.4 m Free
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult buffet lunch, Fri–Sun — ¥158 (≈$22, was ¥268, about 41% off) · Valid Nov 7 – Dec 31, 2026 · Each adult brings 1 child under 1.4 m free · Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

NINE restaurant at W Xiamen is marking the hotel’s 5th anniversary with a buffet deal built around a rotating food theme — and right now that theme is German food, running through November 30. Expect the live grill station (steak, German sausages), a seafood spread (big prawns, mussels, scallops, oysters — the garlic-grilled oysters get singled out), sashimi and sushi cut to order, Chinese and Western hot dishes, fresh soups, and a dessert table that riffs on Xiamen’s dice-game (博饼) tradition. Dinner adds hairy crab and the house “circle sausage”, and an autumn/winter hotpot option has just joined the menu.

item.title: Xiamen Portman Seven Star Bay Buffet from ¥219 (≈$31) for 1 Adult + 1 Child: Lunch or Weekday Dinner
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m), lunch or weekday dinner — ¥219 (≈$31, was ¥298) · Valid July 15 – December 30, 2026 · Book at least 1 day ahead

The Portman Seven Star Bay （佰翔波特曼七星湾酒店） sits on the Tong’an coast in Xiamen, and its Le Wei all-day restaurant runs the hotel buffet: lunch 12:00–14:30 every day, dinner 17:30–21:00 (weekdays on this voucher; weekends need the weekend-dinner tier). The spread rotates with the season, but the shape stays the same — seafood, Chinese and Western dishes, and French-style desserts — and the restaurant will make baby food (steamed egg, white congee) for the smallest diners. One child under 1.2 m eats free with each adult; children 1.2–1.4 m take the child ticket, and anyone over 1.4 m pays the adult price.

item.title: Xiamen W Hotel HEAT Bar 2-Hour Cocktail Free-Flow from ¥138 (≈$19): 35th-Floor Skyline Bar, Any Night of the Week
item.description:
Deal price: 2-hour cocktail free-flow — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥446) · HEAT Bar, 35th floor, W Xiamen · Any night 20:00–02:00, any 2 hours · Valid October 28 – December 30, 2026 · ⏰ book by 20:00 the day before

HEAT Bar sits on the 35th floor of Xiamen W Hotel, above the neon of the city — a proper skyline bar for a night out rather than a hotel lobby drink. This voucher covers two hours of free-flow designated cocktails, any night of the week: pick any 2-hour window inside the bar’s 20:00–02:00 opening hours. At ¥138 against a ¥446 list price, it is less than a third of the walk-in cost of the same two hours.

item.title: Xiamen Le Méridien Cantonese Dim Sum Set from ¥138 (≈$19): 10 Dishes for Two, Weekends at No Extra Charge
item.description:
Deal price: Cantonese dim sum set for 2 — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥168) · 10 dishes · Weekdays, weekends and holidays at no extra charge · Valid October 22 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refunded if expired · Book by 20:00 the day before

Le Mei, the Chinese restaurant at Xiamen Le Méridien, does Cantonese dim sum with a Minnan twist — the set for two runs: crispy roast duck, flaky egg tarts, Xiamen taro buns, Le Méridien shrimp dumplings, crab-roe siu mai, garlic steamed pork ribs, red-rice shrimp rice rolls, soy-sauce steamed chicken feet, stir-fried beef rice noodles, and two mango pomelo sago desserts. Served lunch (11:30–14:30) and dinner (17:30–21:00) in a quiet courtyard-garden setting, with a walk through the hotel’s central garden and lawn after the meal.

item.title: Xiamen Marco Polo Napoleon Pastry from ¥68 (≈$9): 2 Signature Slices or a 1-Pound Cake, Weekends at No Extra Charge
item.description:
Deal price: 2 slices of signature Napoleon — ¥68 (≈$9, was ¥96) · Self-pickup from the lobby lounge · Valid October 23, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · ⏰ weekends and holidays at no extra charge, refundable if unreserved · Reserve by 17:00 the day before

The Napoleon is Marco Polo Oriental’s star dessert — layers of flaky pastry folded with butter and nuts, softening as you bite into a milky, crisp sweetness — and this deal is the cheapest way to take it home: two slices for ¥68, or a whole 1-pound Napoleon cake for ¥208 (was ¥258), a natural pick for birthdays, family gatherings and dates. The pastry is takeaway only; eating it in the lobby lounge seats is charged at the walk-in price.

item.title: Xiamen SM voco Weekend Buffet from ¥178 (≈$25): 1 Adult + 1 Child Lunch or Dinner at the 'Shan' Restaurant
item.description:
Deal price: Weekend lunch, 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.4 m) — ¥178 (≈$25, was ¥268) · Saturdays and Sundays, 12:00–14:00 · At the hotel’s 2nd-floor “Shan” all-day restaurant · Valid October 22, 2026 – February 28, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry · Book by 23:59 the day before

A straightforward weekend family buffet in central Xiamen: the voco hotel at SM City Plaza (Jiahe Road, Siming District, served by Metro Line 1) opens its 2nd-floor “Shan” all-day restaurant for a weekend lunch or dinner buffet, with one child under 1.4 m included in every tier. Lunch runs Saturdays and Sundays from 12:00 to 14:00; dinner runs Fridays and Saturdays from 17:30 to 21:00. Dishes follow the restaurant’s daily spread, so the exact stations vary by day.

item.title: Xiamen Marriott Haicang — Breakfast Buffet for Two from ¥99 (≈$14)
item.description:
Deal price: breakfast buffet for two — ¥99 (≈$14) (was ¥276) · Single breakfast × 10, splittable — ¥458 (≈$64, was ¥2,760) · Daily: weekdays 6:30–10:00, weekends and holidays 6:30–10:30 · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027

Xiamen Marriott Haicang (厦门泰地万豪酒店) sits on Haicang Avenue in the Haicang CBD, across the water from Xiamen Island. Its ground-floor Gongchu restaurant serves a full breakfast buffet every morning: hot dishes cooked several ways, freshly steamed dim sum and mixed-grain items, crispy youtiao (great dunked in soy milk or noodle soup), a bread corner with European-style loaves, toast and scones, plus congee, soy milk, milk and noodle soup — Chinese and Western tastes both covered, in a bright, spacious dining room with an open kitchen.

item.title: Xiamen Marriott Haicang — Gongchu Dinner Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: single dinner buffet — ¥158 (≈$22) (was ¥288) · 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.4 m) — ¥188 (≈$26, was ¥432) · 5-meal bundle (splittable) — ¥690 (≈$97, was ¥1,440, about ¥138 per meal) · Thursday–Sunday 17:30–21:00 · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027 (not usable Dec 24–25)

Xiamen Marriott Haicang (厦门泰地万豪酒店) sits on Haicang Avenue in the Haicang CBD, across the water from Xiamen Island. Its ground-floor Gongchu buffet restaurant runs an open kitchen serving a rotating seasonal spread: a seafood section with live-caught steamed seafood and crayfish, a sashimi and Japanese counter, a hot-dish range including fragrant clay-pot (啫啫煲) dishes, and a dessert station — with the menu changing by season, so the day’s actual dishes are what the restaurant serves that evening.

item.title: Xiamen Xianglu International Hotel Buffet — Chaoshan Beef Hotpot Feast, ¥108 (≈$15)
item.description:
Deal price: single buffet, lunch or dinner interchangeable — from ¥108 (≈$15) (was ¥198, about 55% of list) · Weekends & holidays included · ⏰ valid through Mar 10, 2027

Xianglu International Hotel’s Four Seasons restaurant has switched its buffet to a Chaoshan beef hotpot theme for autumn and winter — and at ¥108 it’s one of the best-value hotel buffets in Xiamen right now. The star is fresh-cut beef, sliced to order and never held overnight: dip it for seconds in a clear southern-ginger beef-bone broth or a satay-spiced pot, with the classic Chaoshan dips (satay sauce, Puning bean paste, celery bits) ready to go. Alongside the beef: sliced chicken, pork and lamb rolls, mushrooms, tofu and vegetable sides, meatballs and fish balls, and a rotating cast of small eats.

item.title: Xiamen Renaissance Hotel Saturday Dinner Buffet: 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥178 (≈$25) — Hairy Crab Season
item.description:
Deal price: ¥178 (≈$25, was ¥298 — 40% off) for 1 adult + 1 child · ⏰ Saturday evenings 17:30–21:00 · Valid September 12 – December 31, 2026 · Refundable if unbooked

A Saturday-night buffet built for the season: the headline ¥178 tier covers 1 adult + 1 child under 1.4 m at the Renaissance Xiamen’s dinner buffet, with seasonal hairy crab, freshly sliced Hetian chicken, seafood sashimi and unlimited red and white wine among the spreads. Menus rotate with the season, so the exact dishes follow what the restaurant is serving that night.

item.title: Xiamen Le Méridien Buffet 4-Visit Card ¥598 (≈$84) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid: Lunch or Dinner + Hairy Crab + 600㎡ Kids' Playground
item.description:
Deal price: ¥598 (≈$84, was ¥912) · ⏰ Valid Oct 24 – Dec 31, 2026 · 🦀 4 visits × (1 adult + 1 kid under 1.4m), lunch or dinner · 🎠 4 kids’ playground tickets included · Refundable if unreserved

Four weekend feasts for the price of one-and-a-half: this 4-visit card for Xiamen Le Méridien’s 新食谱 (Xinshipu) all-day restaurant works out to just ¥149.50 per visit — each visit covering 1 adult + 1 child under 1.4m for either lunch or dinner. Every sitting comes with hairy crab (the seasonal headline), iced seafood and salmon sashimi, all-you-can-eat crawfish and grilled oysters, rotating steak, chicken steak and fish, Cantonese roast meats, hand-pulled noodles, the chef’s signature pizza, plus free-flow red/white wine, beer and soft drinks. The dessert corner runs from cakes and candied hawthorn skewers to stir-fried ice, four-fruit soup and an ice-cream counter.

item.title: Xiamen Marco Polo Buffet Lunch ¥148 (≈$21) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid: Famous Napoleon Cake, Steamed Seafood & Grill Stations
item.description:
Deal price: ¥148 (≈$21, was ¥268) · ⏰ Valid Oct 23, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · 🍰 Kid under 1.4m eats with you — free-upgraded to 1.5m if redeemed by Nov 30 · Refundable if unreserved

In Xiamen, “Marco Polo” is practically shorthand for one dessert: the Napoleon cake. Locals line up for a single slice on an ordinary day — with this deal, you can eat as many as you want. Twenty-plus years in the making, the Marco Polo buffet at Xiamen Marco Polo Oriental Hotel (Hubin North, Siming — Metro Line 2 straight to the door) still draws crowds for its steamed seafood (prawns, mussels, oysters, scallops, razor clams, tiny red snails — you pick, they steam), sushi from the hotel’s own Japanese restaurant (将军日本餐厅 chefs on duty), and the live grill stations that made its name — “big slabs of meat, generous pours,” in the buffet’s own unapologetic words.

item.title: Xiamen Marco Polo Buffet — ¥138 (≈$19)/Person: Steamed Seafood, Unlimited Sashimi & the Famous Napoleon Pastry
item.description:
Deal price: ¥1,380 for 10 — works out to ¥138/person (≈$19, was ¥198) · ⏰ Valid Oct 23, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or public holidays

The Marco Polo Oriental Hotel’s buffet (8 Jianye Road, Siming District) has been a Xiamen institution for over 20 years, and in Xiamen “Marco Polo” is practically shorthand for its Napoleon pastry — the flaky, cream-layered signature that locals swear by and that here you can eat without limit. The spread runs to a hundred-plus dishes built around live cooking: steamed seafood (shrimp, mussels, oysters, scallops, clams and razor clams — pick what you like and it’s steamed on the spot), a Japanese sushi and sashimi station run by the chefs of the hotel’s Shogun Japanese restaurant (lunch sashimi is unlimited, per long-standing guest reports), a charcoal grill station doing meat the hearty way, a made-to-order noodle bar (noodles, rice noodles or rice cakes with your choice of broth and toppings), plus Chinese and Western hot and cold dishes, salads, puddings, cakes, yogurt and mousse. The café-style dining room runs an open kitchen, so the cooking happens in front of you.

item.title: Guangzhou Emerald Hilton “Ice BBQ & Beer Festival” Buffet from ¥218 (≈$30): Charcoal Oysters, Thick-Cut Salmon & Free-Flow Drinks
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid buffet — from ¥218 (≈$30, was ¥416) · Lunch Sat/Sun from ¥218 · Dinner Tue–Sun from ¥228 · Valid Jul 10 – Nov 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable anytime if unreserved

The Guangzhou Emerald Hilton (Hilton Guangzhou Science City, 28 Ningcai Road, Huangpu District) is running its “Ice BBQ & Beer Food Festival” theme buffet, and the grill station is the headline: charcoal-grilled Rushan oysters from Yantai, shucked and roasted to order, alongside roughly 22cm grilled squid skewers, satay skewers and slow-roasted beef leg. The crab lineup alone runs six ways — curry crab, black-pepper crab, typhoon-shelter crab, ginger-scallion crab, cheese-baked crab and a Luzon-sauce crab — and the cold side counters with thick-cut salmon and 5+ sashimi varieties over 10+ live-cooking stations and 100+ dishes in total.

item.title: Guangzhou Hilton Curio Seafood Buffet 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥168 (≈$24): Oysters, Sashimi & Free-Flow Drinks
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid lunch buffet — ¥168 (≈$24, was ¥308, 45% off) · Dinner ¥228 (≈$32) · Valid Aug 29 – Nov 30, 2026 · Lunch Sat/Sun only, dinner Fri–Sun, no weekend surcharge · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Jiangxin Ge （匠心阁）, on the 3rd floor of the Curio Collection by Hilton Guangzhou, is the in-house buffet of the Greater Bay Area’s first Curio hotel — opened in March 2026 inside the reborn Guangzhou Building （广州大厦）, a Beijing Road landmark in Yuexiu District, right next to the Museum of the Nanyue King. Hilton’s Curio brand skips the cookie-cutter formula, and this one leans into Cantonese flavors: live-cooked Chaoshan fish, a Chinese noodle station, dim sum and the signature Hainan qingbuliang dessert soup alongside the international stations.

item.title: Xiamen Haiyue Shanzhuang — 5-Visit Buffet Pass from ¥666 (≈$93): Lunch or Dinner, Weekends OK
item.description:
Deal price: 5-visit buffet pass — lunch ¥666 (≈$94) (was ¥1,888) · 5-visit dinner pass ¥919 (≈$129) (was ¥2,688) · ⏰ valid through Jan 31, 2027 (not usable Dec 24)

The Haiyue Shanzhuang (海悦山庄） at 3999 Huandao South Road is one of Xiamen’s grand old seaside resorts — a vast mountain-and-sea garden property on the Huangcuo beach side of the island. Its Mediterranean Café on the 2nd floor runs the buffet: window seats look over the blue infinity pool and the gardens, and the stations run ten-plus themes deep — grill, Japanese, Chinese hot dishes, seafood, noodles and pastries, desserts — with 100+ dishes in all, from fresh coastal seafood and sashimi to old-school Minnan snacks. This pass covers 5 visits and is usable on weekends and public holidays at no surcharge, which is what makes it a family staple rather than a weekday-only curiosity.

item.title: Xiamen Millennium Harbourview — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Buffet ¥198 (≈$28), Weekends No Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid buffet (lunch or dinner) — ¥198 (≈$28) (was ¥265) · Solo ¥168 · 2 adults ¥320 · Kid ¥128 · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · Fri–Sun and holidays, no surcharge

The Millennium Harbourview （海景千禧大酒店， 12-8 Zhenhai Road, Siming) sits right by the Zhonghua City shopping district — Metro Line 1 to Zhenhai Road station, then a short walk. Its Harbour Café on the ground floor is done in soft Morandi tones with marble counters and rose-gold lighting, and the buffet runs to roughly a hundred dishes: a hot-dish line whose theme rotates weekly (cream-garlic cheese-baked mussels, French red-wine pear with honey-glazed goose steak, rosemary lamb chops, ham-and-mushroom lasagna), a grill station working through ten-plus seasonal seafoods and meats — small yellow croaker, baby squid, T-bone steak, chicken chops, skewers — cooked on the iron plate in front of you, and a proper Xiamen showing in the cold seafood: prawns, crabs, scallops, oysters, plus local specialties like tusundong (sea-worm jelly), aged razor clams and marinated fish skin. There’s a noodle station with your pick of ingredients in clear or spicy broth, thick-cut sashimi and handmade sushi, and a dessert wall of 20-plus sweets — signature cheesecake, Napoleon, crème brûlée, mango pomelo sago, milk-tea mousse, fruit tarts.

item.title: Xiamen Sheraton — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Buffet ¥138 (≈$19), Weekends & Holidays
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid (under 1.3 m) buffet — ¥138 (≈$19) (was ¥298, about 46% of list) · Saturdays & Sundays · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026

The Xiamen Sheraton on Jiahe Road in Huli — a 10-minute walk from the metro and right by the SM City mall — runs its all-you-can-eat at the Ocean Wave Pan-Asian restaurant. The format Xiamen families keep coming back for is the seafood: much of it is the day’s catch, piled up at the seafood station — prawns, shellfish and scallops — next to a circular Japanese counter doing thick-cut sashimi (salmon, octopus, mackerel), a live teppanyaki grill station cooking skewers and meats to order, dozens of Chinese hot dishes and steamed dim sum, double-boiled soups, and a dessert spread with seasonal fruit to finish. Open kitchens and live-cooking counters keep it lively rather than hushed.

item.title: Foshan Marriott Zhen Chu — Dinner Buffet from ¥279 (≈$39) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid (Wed/Thu/Sun)
item.description:
Deal price: dinner for 1 adult + 1 kid — ¥279 (≈$39) (was ¥318) · 2 adults + 2 kids — ¥529 (≈$75, was ¥619) · Valid Jan 15, 2026 – Jan 15, 2027 · usable Wednesdays, Thursdays and Sundays only, 18:00–21:00

A Marriott-grade family dinner by Qiandeng Lake in Foshan’s Nanhai district. The Zhen Chu Western Restaurant （臻厨西餐厅） sits on the 5th floor of the Lizhi Hui Plaza （丽致汇广场， 38 Haiba East Road) inside the Foshan Marriott — a European-castle-styled hotel that has become a landmark on the lake. The dinner buffet runs around 100 land-and-sea dishes, and it leads with seafood: swimming crab, emerald snails, flower snails, mussels, scallops and big prawns laid out by the plate, plus a lobster course served to your table. Around that core there’s a sashimi and sushi counter, a long run of hot dishes, and a dessert-and-drinks finish. The value jumps on the 2-adult-2-kid bundle, which prices a family of four’s dinner at barely more than one adult’s door price elsewhere.

item.title: Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay Family Lunch — ¥119 (≈$17) for 1 Adult + 1 Kid, was ¥228
item.description:
Deal price: weekday lunch, 1 adult + 1 kid under 6 — ¥119 (≈$17) (was ¥228) · Valid Oct 10, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refunded on expiry

The Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay （厦门五缘湾凯悦酒店） was Xiamen’s first Hyatt-branded hotel, set on Wuyuan Bay — the bay locals call the prettiest in the city — and connected directly to the Bayview City shopping mall. Its Marketplace Café on the first floor runs an open-kitchen buffet built around a “freshly made” idea: dishes are stir-fried, pan-fried and grilled to order rather than sitting under heat lamps. Expect seafood hot dishes, a live teppanyaki station, sashimi, roast duck, sushi and a noodle bar, plus a dessert run that punches above lunch-buffet weight — lemon Basque cheesecake, cherry chocolate cake and yuzu cheesecake among them.

item.title: Xiamen Tianyuan Hotel Seaview Buffet — from ¥158 (≈$22) per Adult (Kid under 1.2 m Free), was ¥208
item.description:
Deal price: adult lunch from ¥158 (≈$22, was ¥208) — each adult brings one kid under 1.2 m free · Lunch daily 11:30–14:00 · Dinner Thu–Sun 17:30–21:00 · Valid Jan 15 – Dec 31, 2026 · Phone booking required (see below)

Ask Xiamen locals which hotel buffet punches above its price and the Tianyuan Hotel （厦门天元酒店） keeps coming up. Its Taste all-day restaurant (1F, 1813 Huandao East Road, in the AVIC Zijin Plaza by the convention center) runs nearly ten stations with two claims to fame: salmon sashimi and pan-seared foie gras, both unlimited — the foie gras seared crisp outside, molten inside, finished with a sweet-tart blueberry sauce. Add fresh-cut sashimi (salmon, sea bream, vinegared mackerel), grilled steak and squid skewers on the teppanyaki, Turkish kebab you slice yourself and wrap in flatbread, roast duck, Minnan specialties like 土笋冻 (sea-worm jelly), a made-to-order noodle bar with chicken or satay broth, and a dessert counter anchored by the hotel’s signature cheesecake (one or two varieties daily, famously not too sweet), Black Forest cake and crème brûlée. Dinner adds red wine and a seasonal served dish for adults.

item.title: Xiamen InterContinental Seaview Hotel — Weekend 1 Adult + 1 Child Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m) — weekend lunch ¥158 (≈$22) / dinner ¥198 (≈$28) · Lunch Sat–Sun 11:30–14:00 · Dinner Wed–Sat 17:30–21:00 · Valid Sep 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 21:00 the day before

The InterContinental Xiamen （厦门海景洲际酒店） sits on the quiet eastern end of Huandao Road, steps from the beach and the convention center — look for the giant whale sculpture floating above the lobby, the hotel’s beloved mascot. Its Straits all-day restaurant runs the buffet families keep coming back for: 9 stations and 100+ dishes, currently in seafood season. Dinner is where the big guns come out — king crab legs on weekend evenings, Alaska snow crab legs on weekday evenings, plus Taiwan oysters, razor clams and a rotating cast of Fujian-style seafood, all self-serve. The sashimi counter cuts tuna, salmon and octopus to order; the teppanyaki station does steaks, lamb chops and skewers with the occasional flame show; and there are noodle soups (wonton, Xiamen satay, chicken broth), German pork knuckle, BBQ ribs, a chocolate fountain, and red and white wine included at dinner.

item.title: Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay Weekday Buffet — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Lunch ¥168 (≈$24)
item.description:
Deal price: weekday lunch, 1 adult + 1 kid under 6 — ¥168 (≈$24) (was ¥228, ~26% off) · Weekend tier ¥188 (≈$26) · Bookable Jan 21 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ Lunch 11:30–14:00, reserve by 21:00 the day before

The Market Café on the ground floor of the Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay — Xiamen’s first Hyatt-branded hotel, attached to the Wanyuecheng mall in Huli District and a short walk from Wuyuan Wetland Park — runs its lunch buffet (11:30–14:00) as a big, open-kitchen spread of 100+ dishes: seafood hot dishes, a teppanyaki grill working steaks and skewers to order, fresh sashimi, roast duck, sushi and live noodle stations, plus juices, tea and coffee. The room is designed as a Minnan “market” with retro patterned floor tiles and open cooking stations, so the meal has some theatre to it.

item.title: Xiamen 'Southeast Asia Food Festival' Weekend Buffet, from ¥108 (≈$15) — Free Hairy Crab
item.description:
Deal price: single buffet lunch ¥108 (≈$15), dinner ¥118 (≈$17) (was ¥198) · Valid Oct 9 – Dec 31, 2026 · Lunch Sat/Sun · Dinner Fri–Sun · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

For its 20th anniversary, the Xianglu International Hotel （翔鹭国际大酒店， 18 Changhao Road, Huli) is running a Southeast Asia Food Festival at its Four Seasons Restaurant — “Nanyang flavours on a Xiamen table.” The lineup is properly regional rather than generic “Asian fusion”: Singapore laksa, tom yum seafood, bak kut teh, Indonesian fried rice and gado-gado salad, Malaysian fried flower cakes, Indian chicken, curry-onion meatballs and satay patties, with Thai green papaya salad and a sour-spicy beef vermicelli salad on the cold side.

item.title: Xiamen Thai Food Festival Buffet at Garden Hotel — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Lunch ¥148 (≈$21)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.3 m lunch — ¥148 (≈$21) (was ¥228) · Dinner ¥188 (≈$26) · Bookable Jul 22 – Dec 30, 2026 · Lunch Sat/Sun, dinner Fri–Sun, weekends and holidays at no surcharge · ⏰ Reserve by 19:00 the day before

The venue is half the story here: the Xiamen Hotel （厦门宾馆） on Huyuan Road in Siming District is a 60-plus-year-old garden property — Minnan red-brick courtyards, quiet grounds in the middle of the city, opposite Xiamen No. 1 Middle School and a short walk from Zhongshan Park metro station and the Wanshi Botanical Garden. Its Pearl of the Sea Café （海上明珠咖啡厅） is currently running a Thai Food Festival theme on top of its regular spread, and the format is an old-school Xiamen buffet done generously.

item.title: Guangzhou Science City Poly Junya — 1 Night + Breakfast for 2 Adults + 2 Kids from ¥518 (≈$73); Buffet Tiers Fri–Sat
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night for 2 adults + 2 kids — from ¥518 (≈$73) (was ¥1,299) · Two-buffet tiers ¥539/¥588, Fridays & Saturdays · All-week breakfast tier ¥518 · ⏰ Valid through Dec 31, 2026, no weekend surcharge

Poly Junya Guangzhou Science City （广州科学城保利郡雅酒店， 99 Lanyue Road, Huangpu) is a 30,000㎡ hotel wrapped in greenery next to the Baiyun ecological reserve — guests keep describing it as a “city forest,” and the rooms (36–40㎡, floors 5–12, King Koil mattresses) face the green. The bundle is built around the Moonlight Western Restaurant, a garden-style buffet room on the ground floor: on buffet nights the theme is BBQ and beer, with sashimi, freshly grilled oysters, skewers, free-flow beer, unlimited salmon — and unlimited Häagen-Dazs. The hotel says the two buffet meals alone are worth ¥700+, which checks out against local pricing (a 2-adult-1-kid buffet dinner here normally runs about ¥338 on its own).

item.title: Guangzhou Aoyuan Sheraton — Korean-Themed Buffet Dinner, 2 Adults + 2 Kids ¥368 (≈$51)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 adults + 2 kids ¥368 (≈$52) (comparable value ¥664 — save ¥216) · 1 adult + 1 kid ¥188 (≈$26) · 5-person dinner ¥888 (≈$125) · kids’ dinner ¥78 (≈$11) · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026 (not valid Dec 24)

The Linlanghui restaurant on the 2nd floor of the Sheraton Guangzhou Panyu (Aoyuan Sheraton, at Nancun Wanbo metro station in Panyu) is running a “Korean flavor” themed buffet dinner — Korean BBQ and fried chicken headline a spread that also runs to fresh-cut Norwegian salmon and sashimi, river prawns and tiger crab, a grill station doing steak, lamb and chicken to order, and individual beef hotpots with three broths (coconut chicken, spicy, beef bone) and 20-plus ingredients including fresh-cut beef and Clearwater chicken. Desserts are a station of their own: chocolate fountain, nine rotating cakes, six ice-cream flavors and churros made on the spot. Red and white wine, beer and sparkling wine are all free-flow, alongside juices, sodas and handmade Hong Kong milk tea.

item.title: Xiamen Yuzhou Wyndham — Buffet + Adventure Island Play, 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥198 (≈$28)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid buffet + Adventure Island ¥198 (≈$28) (was ¥298) · Weekend dinner + park ¥268 (≈$38) · 5-visit cards ¥898/¥1,198 · ⏰ Valid through Dec 31, 2026

The pairing is the point at the Yuzhou Wyndham Grand Xiamen (882 Zhongzhai Road, Huli — the Wuyuan Bay hotel): its Stellar buffet restaurant on one side, a 400㎡ Adventure Island kids’ park on the other, bundled into one ticket for 1 adult + 1 kid (under 1.2 m). The park is a genuine energy-burner across four themed zones: a wonderland adventure area (rock climbing, zip lines, pulley rides), a relic forest (big slides, ball-pit castle), a hands-on flint workshop, and a treasure valley of hoops, claw machines and challenge games. The package even throws in a bonus extra child’s play pass — same-day use only.

item.title: Guangzhou DoubleTree by Hilton — Seafood Hotpot Buffet from ¥188
item.description:
Deal price: ¥188 (≈$26) for 1 adult + 1 kid lunch · 1 adult + 1 kid dinner ¥288 (≈$40) · 2 adults + 2 kids lunch ¥338 (≈$47) · 2 adults + 2 kids dinner ¥498 (≈$69) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

DoubleTree by Hilton Guangzhou (Dongfeng Middle Road, Yuexiu) runs a seafood hotpot–themed buffet where you can have it both ways: pile up salmon, iced seafood, fresh sashimi, Häagen-Dazs and German beer — or drop ingredients into your own little hotpot right at the table. Dinner also comes with signature served dishes brought to your seat.
